spec: §15 suite F (linking); §9.3: unequal closure hashes under one name, or conflicting devices/layout/data entries, are a link error; equal-closure-hash duplicates deduplicate
derivation: Linking caller (F-import-unlinked) against an object defining ext_inc with a different body - hence a different closure hash - under the same name and signature must be a link error, while linking against the identical definition resolves and deduplicates. No reference-CLI command links two objects; linking is exposed only in the library, and bennett_load (the §10 library surface, deliverable 8) is staged.

unavailable.reason: the full §10 launch library (bennett_load and its linking) is staged deliverable 8; the CLI has no link command
